protocol.scope: Node synchronous wall time for full gameView HTML construction and for eventRiskPreview only. No DOM, CSS, layout, input-to-paint, storage, GPU or naturally played save claim.
protocol.fixtures: Seed 20261020 + scenario floor. Synthetic valid 3/100/1000/10000-item inventories; five newest items equipped when present. The first route slot is deliberately set to the tested event before the real enter transition.
protocol.quantiles: sorted floor((n-1)*p); every formal value retained
protocol.comparison: Baseline gameView lacks the new preview; current gameView includes it after UI integration. Outputs intentionally differ, while every input field and runtime rules must be preserved. This measures added capability cost, not a same-output optimisation.
protocol.preview: Calls roll for both event types and safe additionally for gambit, matching both available paid choice quotes. No preview baseline exists.
protocol.instrumentation: Detached item-id getters are installed only after every native timing cell finishes. They count ID reads, not total allocations or CPU instructions, and never touch timed object shapes.
limits: Shared host GC/scheduling can affect tails.
HTML construction is only one part of browser responsiveness.
A new decision panel may add HTML even if its model is cheap; page timing must be measured separately.
